subject: Culture
title: Honor vs Guilt Societies
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Honor vs Guilt Societies.

hook.text: In Tokyo a CEO bows on live TV to apologize. In New York a CEO calls a lawyer instead.

buildup.text: Ruth Benedict split cultures into two types: guilt cultures led by conscience and shame cultures led by reputation.

discovery.text: Guilt cultures punish internally. You feel bad even if nobody saw. Shame cultures punish socially.

twist.text: Most societies blend both. Japan uses shame publicly and guilt privately. America uses guilt but fears cancellation.

climax.text: The internet turned the whole world into a shame culture overnight.

punchline.text: Your moral compass depends on who's watching.

quiz.question: Who introduced the honor-shame vs guilt-culture framework?
